summary: Ship recipient subject body mail fields inside Event Note bubbles
description: Resolve overlapping issues3 and5 using the latest three-field requirement: verified recipients, subject and body; role-preserving optional Cc/Bcc, unresolved-recipient handling, source binding, native copy behavior, opt-in checker and templates; release and update both vaults without historical bulk conversion.
acceptance: Issues3 and5 latest criteria are implemented consistently in policy, skills, executable validation and fictional fixtures.
To, subject and plaintext body copy independently in native Obsidian; source bindings and mail state stay inside the named author bubble outside copy blocks.
Recipient evidence, unresolved addresses, Cc/Bcc separation, quote/fence integrity and mixed-mode safety have positive and negative tests; no send or task-state side effects.
Reviewed PR, release, both drift-safe vault updates, local checks and source writeback are verified.
